definitions.gloss: sold separately; available as a separate purchase
definitions.explanation: Indicates that an item is not included with the main product and must be purchased independently.

examples.japanese: ⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別売|べつう}りです。
⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別売|べつう}りな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please note that batteries are sold separately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充電器|じゅうでんき}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別売|べつう}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三千円|さんぜんえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The dedicated charger is sold separately and costs 3,000 yen.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate) + ⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧ (selling). Very common in product descriptions, packaging, and online shopping. Often appears as a note or disclaimer.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {別売|べつう}りです (is sold separately)
- {別売|べつう}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (separately sold ~)
- {別売|べつう}り⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (separately sold item)
- {別売|べつう}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to purchase separately)

TYPICAL ITEMS MARKED {別売|べつう}り:
- ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧ (batteries)
- ⟦{充電器|じゅうでんき}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧ (charger)
- ⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧ / ⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧ (case / cover)
- ⟦{付属品|ふぞくひん}→付属品：18630_fuzokuhin⟧ (accessories)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付属|ふぞく}→付属：27518_fuzoku⟧: included, bundled (opposite concept)
- ⟦{同梱|どうこん}→同梱：21093_doukon⟧: packaged together
- ⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: sold as a set
